subject: 🤝 Support Referral — $referral_service
body:
Hi $student_name,

A member of staff has referred you to $referral_service — the team will reach out to you shortly to arrange a first conversation. We wanted to let you know so the contact isn't a surprise.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
REFERRAL DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Referral ID:      $referral_id
Referral Service: $referral_service
Referred By:      $referred_by ($referred_by_role)
Referred On:      $referral_date
Urgency:          $urgency
Concern Type:     $concern_type

WHY THE REFERRAL
────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$referral_reason
────────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHAT TO EXPECT

  • The service will email you within $expected_response_days working days to arrange a first chat.
  • The first conversation is informal and confidential — there is no obligation to take up further sessions.
  • You can decline the referral or ask for a different team; just reply to this email.
  • If you need urgent help before they reach you, contact $urgent_contact.

Referrals are made in good faith; nothing about them appears on your academic transcript. If you have concerns about how the referral was made or what was shared, please contact the Student Advice Centre.

Kind regards,
Student Support Office
